categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of various hinge products, precision metal parts, springs, and metal injection molding (MIM) components. Its products serve notebook computers, LCD monitors, wearable devices, foldable phones, and other 3C electronic products. The business also includes precision machining, assembly, and customized automation equipment design and sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced mechanical structure design, precision stamping, CNC machining, metal injection molding, and automated assembly lines. It emphasizes process automation, quality control, and innovative hinge technologies such as foldable and autolock hinges. The production processes include surface treatments, heat treatments, and precision assembly with strict quality management systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major global notebook computer, LCD monitor, and wearable device manufacturers, including well-known brands like Dell, HP, Lenovo, Apple, and Taiwanese ODMs such as Foxconn and Quanta. The company serves the consumer electronics, communication, automotive, and medical device industries, focusing on 3C products and emerging markets like foldable devices and AR/VR equipment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan, China (Suzhou, Chongqing, Dongguan, Kunshan, and Fujian), and Vietnam, with production bases expanding in Vietnam and China. Sales are predominantly in Asia (97%), with minor sales in Taiwan, the Americas, and Europe. It maintains global partnerships with international brand manufacturers and ODMs.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned in the midstream of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and assembly of hinge components and precision metal parts. It collaborates closely with upstream raw material suppliers and downstream system integrators and brand manufacturers, providing integrated hinge solutions and precision components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding hinge product development, especially for foldable and wearable devices, advancing low-carbon and sustainable materials, and enhancing production automation. R&D focuses on torque self-adjustment devices, fatigue life prediction, and automated inspection equipment. The company also pursues ESG initiatives, green manufacturing, and supply chain sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of hinges, precision metal parts, and related components. The company also earns income from international trade and investment holdings in subsidiaries. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models but focuses on manufacturing and sales contracts with major electronics manufacturers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the global hinge and precision metal parts market for notebook computers, LCD monitors, and wearable devices. It competes with other precision component manufacturers and ODM suppliers, leveraging advanced R&D, automation, and strong customer relationships to maintain market share despite intense price competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$13.3 billion in the latest fiscal year, a 32% increase from the prior year, with a net profit of NT$1.36 billion, up 68%. It maintains a healthy financial structure with a low debt ratio (~23%) and strong liquidity. The company is expanding production capacity in Vietnam and China to support growth and diversification.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-precision, reliable hinge and metal component solutions tailored for advanced electronic devices, including foldable and wearable products. Its competitive edge lies in comprehensive product lines, strong R&D capabilities, automated manufacturing, and close collaboration with global brand customers. Sustainability and ESG integration further differentiate its offerings.
